'''Administrative Way''' was an avenue that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Xakrea]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell]], during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. The avenue branched out from the city's central plaza.
